connector.name: Spala Public MCP
connector.registryDescription: Discovery, OAuth, project operations, and exact project MCP handoff for Spala backend projects.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.spala.ai over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.spala, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
